## Pythonae (CR 12)

This huge serpent’s scales glitter green where they are not covered in mud. It almost appears to give you a clever, knowing smile while it crawls out of a vast crevice in the earth.  

**XP** 19,200  
N Huge dragon (earth)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +24  


**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 12, flat-footed 23 (+4 Cha, +15 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 157 (15d12+60)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +14, **Will** +15  
**Defensive Abilities** nature’s whispers, noxious slime (DC 20), spirit of nature (fast healing 3 for 1d4 round when reduced to negative hit points); **DR** 10/—; **Immune** paralysis, poison, sleep; **SR** 23  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., burrow 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +22 (4d6+12/19-20), tail slap +21 (4d6+12 plus grab)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (4d6+12), erosion touch 6/day (15d6 damage), intoxicating breath (20-ft. radius cloud, poison, Fortitude DC 21 negates)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 15th; concentration +19)  


4/day—undo artifice (DC 22)  


**Oracle Spells Known** (CL 15th; concentration +19)  


7th-Level (4/day)—creeping doom<sup>M</sup> (DC 21), poison breath (DC 21), regenerate  

6th-Level (6/day)—overwhelming poison, plague storm (DC 20), prognostication, stone tell<sup>M</sup>  

5th-Level (6/day)—awaken<sup>M</sup>, commune, greater contagion (DC 19), true seeing (DC 19), wall of stone (DC 19)  

4th-Level (7/day)—aura of doom (DC 18), deathlessmdva, divination, foretell failure, grove of respite <sup>M</sup>  

3rd-Level (7/day)—bestow curse (DC 17), blindness/deafness (DC 17), meld into stone, speak with plants<sup>M</sup>, water breathing  

2nd-Level (7/day)—augury, barkskin<sup>M</sup>, blood of the martyrchotr (DC 16), grace, ironskin, lay of the land  

1st-Level (7/day)—blend with surroundings (DC 15), cause fear (DC 15), charm animal<sup>M</sup> (DC 15), ferment, sanctuary (DC 15), stone shield  

0th-Level (at will)—bleed (DC 14), create water, detect magic, detect poison, guidance, read magic, resistance, sotto vocefg (DC 14), stabilize  


**Mystery** Nature  


**Statistics**


**Str** 26, **Dex** 16, **Con** 19, **Int** 12, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +25 (+29 grapple); **CMD** 39 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Prophetic Visionary, Skill Focus (Stealth), Stealthy, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +22, Knowledge (arcana, religion) +19, Perception +24, Sense Motive +24, Stealth +23, Swim +26  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Terran, Undercommon  
**SQ** natural divination 4/day, oracle’s curse (putrid WO)  


**Special Abilities**



**Intoxicating Breath (Su)** Whoever inhales a pythonae’s breath weapon suffers the same effects as if they had ingested dreamtime tearg, included the risk of developing an addiction to it. The breath weapon cloud dissipates after 1 round. The DC save is Constitution-based.  

**Oracular** A pythonae casts spells and has access to a mystery and an oracle’s curse as if it were a 15th-level oracle. It has no automatic access to cure/inflict spells as an oracle.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** deep caverns and swamps  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or nest (2-4)  
**Treasure** triple
